svg.aria-label: From a queued job to a single-use runner pod: 1. Listen: A listener pod long-polls GitHub for jobs on the home-ops and ai-k8s-sandbox repos. 2. Scale: The controller creates one single-use runner pod per job, between 1 and 15 pods per scale set. 3. Register: Each runner registers with GitHub using skrumbach-runner-secret, synced from the 1Password item github. 4. Run: The job runs in the runner container. The home-ops set adds a talosctl binary; the sandbox set adds a privileged Docker sidecar. 5. Clean up: The pod exits after one job. Its work volume goes with it: an emptyDir on home-ops, a 20 GiB Ceph block claim on the sandbox set.
